facts.fact: The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) requires US healthcare providers to adopt national standards for electronic healthcare transactions, with the goal of protecting the security of individually-identifiable health information.
facts.quote: requires healthcare providers to adopt national standards for electronic healthcare transactions. The goal of this act is to protect the security of individually-identifiable health information.

facts.fact: According to the article, HIPAA means healthcare marketers cannot use CRM data to target anyone who has been a patient, because that data is considered private information.
facts.quote: you’re unable to use data from your CRM to target anyone who has been a patient because that is considered private information.

facts.fact: The article presents 5 programmatic targeting tactics for healthcare digital marketing: custom audience segments, lookalike audiences, third-party data, contextual targeting, and geotargeting.
facts.quote: Below, we’re covering 5 programmatic advertising tactics that you can leverage to take advantage of this growing market and still remain compliant.

facts.fact: Custom Audience Segments use 1st-party proprietary data about content a user has consumed to target based on intent, without identifying what the user has searched.
facts.quote: Custom Audience Segments provide insight into the content that a user is consuming–without identifying what they’ve searched.

facts.fact: Third-party data can target healthcare practitioners through National Provider Identifier (NPI) lists, specialty-level targeting, and clinical behaviours.
facts.quote: Third party data can also be used to target healthcare practitioners in a granular way through the use of National Provider Identifier (NPI) lists, specialty level targeting, and by clinical behaviours

facts.fact: The article describes the patient journey as three stages: awareness, consideration, and conversion.
facts.quote: the patient journey will typically start with the awareness stage.
